query: Where will NeurIPS be located this year?

results.title: NeurIPS 2026 | Mark Riedl
results.content:
NeurIPS will have a satellite location in Atlanta, Georgia USA
Following the success of the EurIPS and NeurIPS-Mexico City pilots in 2025, we are thrilled to announce two official NeurIPS 2026 satellite events for this year!
These will be held in Paris, France and Atlanta, USA, respectively, running alongside the main venue in Sydney, Australia.

results.content:

results.title: NeurIPS Announces Second Physical Location in Mexico City – NeurIPS Blog
results.content:
NeurIPS Announces Second Physical Location in Mexico City
For the first time, in 2025, NeurIPS will host a second official physical location for the conference.
The conference will be held at the San Diego Convention Center and in Mexico City.
The Mexico City location will host approximately five hundred attendees.
As we get closer to December, more details about programming, logistics, and attendance at all NeurIPS locations will be available.
